title: asparagus officinalis subsp. altilis
intro: Asparagus officinalis subsp. altilis, commonly known as wild asparagus, is a subspecies of asparagus that is native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. It is a perennial plant that offers numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting antioxidant defenses. The therapeutic actions of Asparagus officinalis subsp. altilis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
